prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” HVAC company for every Houston homeowner — the right choice depends on your neighborhood, whether it’s a simple repair or a replacement, your budget, and how quickly you need service. I can recommend well-regarded options and give you a checklist to pick the best one for your situation.

If you want immediate names, these companies are widely recommended in the Houston area (large, well-reviewed, offer emergency service and warranties):
- John Moore Services
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, Air & Electric
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (Houston)
- ABC Home & Commercial Services
- Service Experts (Houston franchises)

How to choose the best one for you
- Verify licensing and insurance (Texas HVAC license and general liability).
- Look for NATE-certified techs and manufacturer certifications.
- Check recent Google, Yelp, and BBB reviews for service quality and responsiveness.
- Ask about flat-rate pricing vs. hourly and get a written estimate.
- Confirm warranty on parts and labor.
- Ask about emergency / same‑day availability and response time.
- Get a clear diagnostic fee and what it covers.

Questions to ask when you call
- Are you licensed and insured in Texas? (ask for license number)
- Do you have experience with my system brand/model?
- What is the diagnostic fee, and is it applied toward repair cost?
- Can you give a rough cost range for common fixes (capacitor, contactor, refrigerant leak, compressor)?
- Do you offer any service/maintenance plans or financing?

Red flags
- Technician won’t provide a written estimate.
- High-pressure push to replace the entire system before diagnosing.
- Repeatedly changing the quoted price or adding “must-have” repairs without explanation.
- Poor or no online reviews, or complaints unresolved on BBB.

If you want, tell me your Houston ZIP code or neighborhood and whether this is an emergency — I can tailor a short list of top-rated providers in your immediate area and include phone numbers and typical wait times.
